SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-02: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — Key Elements: Constants, ViewDefinition.constant, ViewDefinition.constant.name, ViewDefinition.constant.value[x]. Test these items: constant 0..* parsing using the spec singular field name, constant.name 1..1 with sql-name validation and %name FHIRPath reference, value[x] 1..1 exactly-one behavior, primitive value types: base64Binary, boolean, canonical, code, date, dateTime, decimal, id, instant, integer, integer64, oid, string, positiveInt, time, unsignedInt, uri, url, uuid, constant substitution in column paths and where filters, invalid/missing constant values raise explicit spec errors. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.constant.value[x] and Using Constants; FHIRPath N1 grammar externalConstant vs STRING and FHIRPath §4.1.2 String escaping
issues.evidence: fhir4ds-private/docs/prompts/.ai_loop/.temp/qa/sof_vd_02_explorer_constants_probe.log: path "'%idx'" with valueInteger 1 produced row "1" instead of literal "%idx" in both native and forced Python fallback; path "'%missing'" raised undefined constant though %missing is inside a FHIRPath string literal; valueString "O'Reilly" generated FHIRPath name.where(family = 'O''Reilly').family, causing native error and fallback NULL instead of matching family "O'Reilly".
issues.root_cause: Constant references were found and substituted with regex over raw FHIRPath text, so references inside string literals/comments were treated as constants; string constants were escaped with SQL doubled quotes before FHIRPath parsing.
issues.resolution: Added lexical constant scanning that skips FHIRPath string literals, delimited identifiers, and comments; reused it for generator validation and substitution; serialized string-like constants as FHIRPath string literals before SQL escaping.
issues.verified_in: Probe after fix; pytest fhir4ds/viewdef/tests 743 passed; conformance 2822/2822; pytest fhir4ds/ 7280 passed / 5 skipped.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.constant.value[x] includes valueInteger64; FHIR R5 JSON §2.1.6.4.2 says all primitive types other than integer/unsignedInt/positiveInt/decimal/boolean, including integer64, are JSON strings.
issues.evidence: fhir4ds-private/docs/prompts/.ai_loop/.temp/qa/sof_vd_02_explorer_constants_probe.log: parse_view_definition accepted {"valueInteger64": 1234567890123} even though integer64 must be encoded as a JSON string in FHIR JSON.
issues.root_cause: The integer64 primitive validator accepted Python ints even though FHIR JSON represents integer64 as a JSON string.
issues.resolution: Tightened valueInteger64 validation to require JSON strings while resolving validated integer64 constants as numeric FHIRPath literals.
issues.verified_in: Probe after fix; pytest fhir4ds/viewdef/tests 743 passed; conformance 2822/2822; pytest fhir4ds/ 7280 passed / 5 skipped.
